notes:
Overview: Nova Fathom builds enterprise search for regulated verticals (legal, financial). Primary problem: scale semantic search + high-quality rerank across 100M-1B doc vectors while keeping per-query unit cost low.

Key requirements (from calls):
- Index size target: 500M vectors for initial production, planning for 1B in 12 months.
- QPS / throughput: steady-state 2k QPS with peaks up to 5k (global).
- Latency targets: p95 <120ms for retrieval+rerank; p99 target <250ms.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost < $0.003/query (retrieval + rerank).
- Reranker: cross-encoder rerank on top-100 candidates; expecting GPU-accelerated cross-encoder for top-10 final scoring.
- Embedding model preferences: open/quantized embedding models (customer prefers control over model weights), ability to pin versions.
- Operational needs: prefix/KV caching, aggressive batching for embeddings ingestion, incremental indexing and cold/hot tiering for vectorstore.
- Compliance: EU data residency for EU customers, SOC2 + SSO/SAML + audit logs + KMS integration.

Recent timeline + activities:
- 2026-02-15: Intro call (Taylor) — described Redwood runtime and Dedicated offering; they shared scale numbers.
- 2026-02-22: Technical deep-dive (Maya) — discussed batching, KV cache, rerank architecture; customer provided sample corpus metadata (anonymized).
- 2026-02-28: Pricing workshop (Ravi) — walked through reserved capacity models; they asked for granular per-token/per-query math. (ff_2026-02-28_1123)
- 2026-03-04: Security review kickoff — uploaded SAML metadata and security questionnaire (drive link); red team expected on 2026-03-18. (ff_2026-03-04_0915)
- 2026-03-09: Infra call — confirmed need for VPC private plane and on-prem ingestion agent; asked for POC checklist and test plan.

POC plan (agreed):
- Step 1: Pilot ingest 50M vectors into Dedicated trial cluster; verify ingestion throughput and storage footprint (2 weeks).
- Step 2: Run synthetic QPS pattern (steady 2k with bursts to 5k) and measure p95/p99 and cost per query.
- Step 3: Evaluate reranker latency when candidate set = 100; measure GPU-utilized rerank pipeline for top-10.
- Step 4: Test KV/prefix caching and autoscaling behavior under burst.
- Acceptance criteria: p95 <120ms, blended cost < $0.004/query for pilot (goal < $0.003).

Customer quotes & attitudes:
- "We can't accept a black-box cost model—need per-route token/unit breakdown and predictable pricing for 500M+."
- Very pragmatic: cares about operational primitives (caching, batching, tiering) more than model fluff.

Open technical risks called out by SEs:
- Ingest pipeline: need efficient bulk upload and compaction for 500M vectors. Will they support compressed, sharded batched ingestion?
- Rerank infra: cross-encoder throughput at 5k QPS requires careful batching; risk of GPU saturation and queuing spikes.
- Cold vs hot storage: cost model must support tiered storage with retrieval SLO guarantees.

Next actions (short):
- Deliver POC checklist + Dedicated trial config by 2026-03-12 (Maya).
- Security team to respond to questionnaire v4 by 2026-03-16 (Ravi).
- Finance loop: draft T&Cs and reserved capacity pricing for 500M-vector commit by 2026-03-20.

Stubs/links referenced: pricing deck (drive://fathom/pricing-and-commit-models.md), security questionnaire (drive://fathom/security-questionnaire-v4.xlsx), sample metadata csv (drive://fathom/sample-metadata-50k.csv).

Notes on fit: strong OA for Dedicated or Private; Optimize product useful for cost tuning, recommend model/quantization guidance during POC.
